scope: offline strict-R3 long supportive-label research only; no live, canonical production, exchange, or execution artifacts modified
change: Materialise target-only H12 path labels; run strict-OOF direct-label, path-archetype, stable-geometry, and direct-bps-blend ablations; publish one research challenger only.

contracts.causality: The source candidate uses only point-in-time fields. All P1/direct values begin at the frozen signal-close-plus-one-hour decision entry and are labelled available only at decision plus twelve hours.
contracts.invalidity: Rows invalid in the parent policy substrate or lacking a complete H12 path are persisted as target-invalid with every future path/direct value null; they cannot become ordinary failures.
contracts.inference: The sidecar emits supervised labels only. No current live, admission, execution, canonical production, or exchange contract was modified.
contracts.outer_validation: Each outer fold fits only on labels available before held-fold start minus the 12-hour H12 embargo. Invalid paths remain persisted but excluded from all supervised fits.
contracts.geometry: Frozen K8 geometry uses only October--December 2024 rows and excludes those definition rows from later supervised training. Rolling K8 variants keep one fixed geometry bundle for every downstream user within a fold.

validation.result: PASS. 2,820,951 persisted candidates / 1,663,035 valid complete H12 rows; six chronological outer folds; exact candidate identity across every compared arm; target-free input contracts; 12-hour label embargo; frozen geometry definition rows excluded from supervised use; inner strict-OOF residual inputs; stage-3 blend consumes only sealed stage-1 OOF scores.

decision.formula: one-third direct path efficiency expected-policy bps + one-third direct time-to-meaningful-MFE expected-policy bps + one-third frozen prequential upstream bps
decision.promotion: not promoted; shadow full-stack admission/portfolio replay then a later untouched validation period are required
decision.causal_joint_result: C1 Ward K4 soft J2 is a stable, causal signal but does not materially beat the direct-label challenger. M2 50/50 direct/J2 is retained as a non-promoted diagnostic only. C3 HDBSCAN was run with an explicit noise state and rejected on portable economics.
rejected: direct final-return head: constant held score after isotonic clipping
fold-local path GMM as a stable inference representation
frozen or rolling same-bundle K8 geometry residual as a portable downstream layer
C1/C2 causal-regime × path J2 as a standalone promotion candidate
C3 HDBSCAN causal-regime control: portable top-5 is negative
richer J3--J6 and policy-conversion clustering: sequentially gated off after no material J2 win
